initial.lesson:
The contract declares the requirements.

An OpenProse *.prose.md file can describe the goal, scope, inputs and evidence needed to assess the result. It is a technical work specification, not a legal agreement.

Orchestration makes the handoffs explicit.

Compose responsibilities and one-time functions. Use ProseScript when steps or their order matter: prepare, review, then hand off. A compatible agent harness supplies the tools and execution.

The host controls what can actually run.

Permissions, approval gates and checks must exist in the host and connected tools. Markdown alone cannot grant access or enforce a security boundary. We verify host support before relying on it.

The receipt records what was observed.

Keep results, check evidence, blockers and the next action. An agent’s own claim is not an independent check; a receipt is not automatically signed or proof that every requirement passed.
